name: SALMon
description: SALMon is an evaluation suite for speech language models that assesses awareness of acoustic aspects such as background noise, emotion, speaker identity, and room impulse response. It measures model consistency and alignment with spoken text using a modeling-based approach.
reputation: A specialized evaluation suite for speech language models that is research-oriented and not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark is fast to compute and publicly available with code and data.
